the development of a comprehensive dynamic model of the SWM module, which includes the effects of membrane fouling and the associated changes in the fluid dynamics and transport processes.
the effect of fouling layer growth on mass transfer and fluid dynamics in SWM modules.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of a uniform fouling layer on the fluid dynamics and on the mass transfer is qualitatively similar to that of a uniform channel gap reduction.
the effect of a uniform channel gap reduction due to fouling layer growth on flow field characteristics and mass transfer is significant, but not overwhelming.
the present study is a step forward in understanding the complex dynamic behavior of SWM modules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the present approach, based on 3D direct simulation of the altered flow and mass transfer, is a promising tool for the study of SWM module performance.

, in the range of thicknesses considered, the flow field and mass transfer are strongly influenced by the channel gap reduction due to fouling layer growth, but the qualitative characteristics of the flow are similar to those of a clean channel.

, for a uniform fouling layer of thickness h, the flow field and mass transfer in a spacer filled channel can be described by the same equations as in the reference case with no gap reduction, provided that the channel gap is replaced by the reduced gap (h/D).
The main takeaway from our work is that
a uniform reduction of channel gap due to fouling does not significantly change the qualitative characteristics of the flow field.
the fluid dynamics and the mass transfer in spacer filled membrane channels are not strongly affected by the uniform channel gap reduction due to fouling.

the flow field in spacer-filled channels of SWM modules is relatively insensitive to the development of uniform fouling layers on their surfaces, at least for the range of fouling thicknesses studied.
